integrity: Self-contained analytical proof and independently replayable exact rational Collatz-Wielandt/tail certificates for the three parity comparisons; calculations supplement rather than replace the analytic global PSD/universality theorem.
scientific_limitations: The norm of a compact Gaussian Jacobi operator provides an exact spectral characterization rather than an elementary closed form. Two distinct parity switches are proved; uniqueness and total number of switches are not claimed. No uniform conditioning or independent historical priority proof is claimed.
title: Two-temperature circle heat covariances: a sharp Jacobi threshold, boundary universality loss, and two parity switches
